$comment: Sections and tuning. Copy this file to sections.json and edit it, or run as-is to use these examples. Sections are yours to name: add, remove, or rename them and point your feeds and prompts at the ids you choose ('general' is a built-in extra id for multi-topic roundups and needs no entry here). All ranking and ingest knobs live here, not in code.

sections.title: Technology
sections.description: Software, hardware, the internet, and the companies building them.

sections.title: Science
sections.description: Research, space, health, and the natural world.

sections.title: World
sections.description: Politics, business, and events shaping the wider world.

ranking.$comment: score = source weight (decayed per link) plus a velocity boost, scaled by importance and topic centrality. decayHalfLifeHours sets how fast a story fades. quietInflowPerDay/maxDecayStretch stretch decay when few items arrive (weekends), so real stories stay visible. 0 disables it. soloForumFactor haircuts a story whose only source is an open forum until a second source joins. The weekend window (weekendUntilMondayHourUtc, editable in the admin) makes the front page lead with the week in review.

ingest.$comment: maxItemAgeHours drops anything older at fetch time so history never backfills. riverRetentionDays/maxRiverItems bound the raw item stream kept in state. seenHashRetentionDays is how long a URL stays deduped. feedSilentDays is when a quiet feed is flagged as unhealthy (software release feeds, whose url ends in /releases.atom or whose name ends in 'releases', get at least 45 days, since releases ship every few weeks by nature). maxEditorBatch caps how many new items one editor call handles, oldest first, because headline quality drops with batch size; the rest stay unseen and the next run picks them up. digestClusterDays/digestMaxClusters bound how many active clusters each LLM call sees.

polymarket.$comment: Optional house prediction-market story: fires only when a curated Polymarket EVENT market's implied probability swings >= movePointsThreshold points in 24h with at least minLiquidity USD in the book. An empty markets list turns the feature off. A bad slug shows up as a 'could not resolve' note in the admin run log, never as a failed run.

farcaster.$comment: Optional link discovery from a Farcaster channel (add a feed with type 'farcaster' and url 'channel:<id>', plus NEYNAR_API_KEY). A cast carries its links when EITHER the author has real reach OR the cast drew engagement, which keeps spam out without silencing small accounts posting good links.

bots.$comment: Social posting, off by default: with no credentials configured every post is a logged dry-run. siteUrl is the canonical base for links in posts (SITE_URL env overrides it). digestChannel is a Farcaster channel id for the nightly digest cast, empty for none. X posting is capped in code: at most maxAutoPerDay automated posts per day and maxPerMonth posts per calendar month. dailyThread, weeklyThread, and monthlyThread turn the two-tweet digest threads on X on or off (they ride outside the story caps). storyHourUtc makes the automated story post wait for that UTC hour so it goes to the day's real top story rather than the first thing over the bar at 3am. reddit posts yesterday's edition as one comment into a subreddit's daily discussion thread (the sticky whose title starts with dailyTitlePrefix) after postHourUtc, with the top topN stories; it needs REDDIT_CLIENT_ID, REDDIT_CLIENT_SECRET, and a REDDIT_REFRESH_TOKEN minted at /api/admin/reddit-auth, and stays off while subreddit is empty or dailyComment is false.
